title: Vampire Vape Dawn 10ml E-Liquid
description: For those who crave a decadent and fruity taste, this Vampire Vape Dawn 10ml E-Liquid offers a tantalising blend of fruity flavours that is sure to please. Each super smooth draw offers the exquisite fusion of raspberries, blackcurrants, and blueberries in this Vampire Vape Dawn E-Liquid. Unveiling a perfectly balanced flavour profile that combines the natural sweetness of the fruits with a delightful hint of tartness. But that's not all. A refreshing layer of icy menthol sweeps over your taste buds, providing a cool and invigorating sensation. Crafted by Vampire Vape, this Dawn by Vampire Vape has been designed to deliver maximum flavour and satisfying clouds by striking the ideal balance between PG and VG. When choosing the right Vampire Vape Juice nicotine strength for your vaping needs, it's important to know the VG/PG ratio. Please note: The 3 mg nicotine strength has a 50VG/50PG ratio, whilst the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg nicotine strengths have a 40VG/60PG composition. These versatile Vampire Vape juice blends are compatible with a wide range of vape devices. But Dawn by Vampire Vape truly shines when paired with low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits, and pod kits. If you're captivated by the delectable flavours of this Vampire Vape Dawn E-Liquid 10ml, why not explore their other equally delicious E-Liquids. Such as their Vampire Vape Nic Salts or their Vampire Vape Bar Salts ranges? Their E-Liquid ranges cater to every vaper's unique flavour preferences. Ensuring there's always something new and exciting to discover. So whether you crave fruity delights, indulgent desserts, or refreshing menthol blends, you're sure to find the perfect vape juice to satisfy your taste buds and take your vaping to the next level.
